built_to: Aevol is an in silico experimental evolution platform: a digital genetics model in which populations of digital organisms undergo selection and variation, creating a Darwinian dynamics, so that one can study experimentally the impact of selection and variation parameters on the structure of evolved organisms (README).
pressure: The README motivates it by the need to study experimentally how selection (population size, environment, environmental variation) and variation (mutation and rearrangement rates, types of rearrangements, horizontal transfer) shape genome structure (number of genes, synteny, proportion of coding sequences), which requires a precise and realistic model of the genome.
success_means: The README does not state a success metric; the code and examples/basic/README.md measure per-generation fitness of the best individual and population means (stats_best.csv, stats_means.csv), with fitness derived from the metabolic error between an individual's fuzzy phenotype and the phenotypic target (Individual::compute_metabolic_error / compute_fitness).
main_loop_one_sentence: EvolutionRunner::run_evolution loops generation by generation inside one OpenMP parallel region: run_a_step advances AeTime, chooses a reproducer for every grid cell by fitness-proportionate selection (global or local 3x3 neighbourhood), draws mutations per offspring with the cell's PRNG, applies them to the DNA (clones of unmutated parents are reused), re-decodes and re-evaluates mutants (promoters -> RNAs -> proteins -> fuzzy phenotype -> metabolic error -> fitness), records the phylogenetic tree, replaces the population with the new generation and updates the best individual; every checkpoint_frequency generations a checkpoint (and optionally the tree) is written.
lineage_notes: README names no predecessor. AUTHORS lists 'Original authors: Guillaume Beslon, Carole Knibbe, David P. Parsons' and major/other contributors. ChangeLog has entries 'New in 8.0' (MPI support, RAevol, discrete fuzzy) and 'New in 4.4'; CMake project version is 9.4.0. AUTHORS notes SFMT is distributed with Aevol but is a separate package. Legacy autotools remnants remain (doc/Makefile.am, SFMT Makefile.am; user guide still describes ./configure).
